resources.string: A few questions before you start

CoPlanly can hold your family\'s key details — a blood group, allergies, a grandparent\'s phone number — so that whoever is with your child can find their way quickly if something unexpected happens.\n\nAll of it is optional except your name, and you can fill it in later from Settings.
Kept for you and your co-parent, in case of an emergency.
Your name is the one thing the app needs — it labels every event and expense.
One for each child. Medications, activities and school details can be added later, from Settings.
A grandparent, an aunt, an uncle — anyone who might collect your child or be called in an emergency.
These contacts are saved with your child, so add your child first — go back a step, or add them later from Settings.
Set out which days your child is with each of you. You can change it at any time, and your co-parent has to agree to a change.
Pick both if that is your family. You can change this later in Settings.
Child records, contacts and school details
Pet records, vaccinations and the vet\'s number
One for each pet — just a name and what kind. Vaccinations, feeding notes and the vet come later, on the pet\'s own screen.
Half each unless you agree otherwise. Once your co-parent is linked, changing this becomes something they confirm — and expenses already recorded keep the split they were entered under.

If your co-parent already uses CoPlanly, enter their code: the children, pets, custody schedule and cost split they set up are pulled in, so nothing is typed twice. If they don\'t yet, invite them — they will see what you fill in here.
Whatever %1$s has already entered is pulled in for you. Check it on the next steps and add anything missing.
You can go on. Anything still on its way arrives in the background.
Nothing has arrived yet. %1$s\'s phone sends their details the next time it is online — you can continue now, and whatever they entered will appear later.
Entered by %1$s. Check the details and add anything missing.
Half each unless you agree otherwise. This becomes the split you share with %1$s; changing it later is something they confirm — and expenses already recorded keep the split they were entered under.
Already agreed with %1$s. Move the slider to propose a different split — they will be asked to confirm it.
A schedule is already set up: %1$s. Check it, or finish now and change it later from Settings.
What you entered on this step has not been saved. Skip moves on without it; Next saves it.
Shared with your co-parent, and used for every expense you record from now on.
